stepTitle: Use $$\text{dist\_from\_bell}$$ as an additional predictor variable.
stepBody: Malavikha trains $$\hat{\text{attendance\_rate}} $$=$$ \hat{\theta}_0 + \hat{\theta}_1 (\text{dist\_from\_bell})**2 + \hat{\theta}_2 \sqrt{\text{section\_no}}$$ without regularization. After applying bootstrapping, she observes a high model bias squared. Can the following suggestion reduce model bias squared?
